correctness.rationale: Unitary Zak Parseval gives exact energy multiplier. Poisson Fourier identity and geometric sums give an explicit nonnegative rational expression increasing in cos(2πx). Hyperbolic-cosine minimization across both fractional-part branches gives A exactly; strict convexity and endpoint gluing give B exactly. Zak fiber concentration proves sharpness; monotonicity and Taylor establish the unique optimal offset and quadratic collapse. Direct spatial-Zak and grid tests in verify_bounds.py passed. Finite tests support but do not replace the general proof.
